# GitHub

> GitHub is the AI-powered developer platform providing code collaboration, CI/CD automation, security, and AI-assisted development tools for individuals, teams, and enterprises.

GitHub offers a comprehensive suite of development tools centered around version control, automation, and artificial intelligence. The platform emphasizes AI integration through GitHub Copilot, advanced security features, and modern DevOps capabilities to enable developers and teams to build, ship, and secure software at scale.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Advanced Security
- CI/CD automation
- Code review
- GitHub Codespaces
- GitHub Enterprise
- Secret Protection
- Code Security
- GitHub Issues
- Dependabot
- Collaboration tools
- AI models
- Workflow automation
- Developer platform

## AI-Powered Development

- [GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot): GitHub Copilot AI code completion product with IDE integration and enterprise features.
- [GitHub Spark](https://github.com/features/spark): GitHub Spark full-stack AI-powered app builder with natural language interface.
- [GitHub Models](https://github.com/features/models): GitHub Models platform for accessing AI models with API and deployment tools.
- [MCP Registry](https://github.com/mcp): MCP Registry centralizing MCP servers for AI agent integration and discovery.

## Core Development Features

- [GitHub Features](https://github.com/features): GitHub Features overview covering collaboration, CI/CD, security, and automation.
- [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/features/actions): GitHub Actions CI/CD automation platform with workflow and marketplace features.
- [GitHub Code Review](https://github.com/features/code-review): GitHub Code Review with pull requests, branch protection, and team workflow.
- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/features/issues): GitHub Issues project planning and issue tracking tool for developer collaboration.
- [GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces): GitHub Codespaces cloud development environment for browser-based remote coding.

## Security & Protection

- [GitHub Advanced Security](https://github.com/security/advanced-security): GitHub Advanced Security with vulnerability detection, secret scanning, and protection.
- [GitHub Code Security](https://github.com/security/advanced-security/code-security): GitHub Code Security with CodeQL analysis, vulnerability detection, and Copilot Autofix.
- [GitHub Secret Protection](https://github.com/security/advanced-security/secret-protection): GitHub Secret Protection with push protection and secret scanning for credentials.

## Enterprise & Teams

- [GitHub Enterprise](https://github.com/enterprise): GitHub Enterprise AI-powered platform with advanced security and governance.
- [GitHub for Teams](https://github.com/team): GitHub for Teams with CI/CD, Dependabot, and collaboration tools.
- [Why Choose GitHub?](https://github.com/why-github): Why GitHub page highlighting platform benefits, enterprise solutions, and Copilot.
- [GitHub for Startups](https://github.com/enterprise/startups): GitHub for Startups program offering credits, Copilot, and enterprise support.

## Resources & Marketplace

- [GitHub Docs](https://docs.github.com): GitHub documentation hub covering platform, APIs, CI/CD, security, and enterprise.
- [GitHub Marketplace](https://github.com/marketplace): GitHub Marketplace with apps, AI models, and tools for workflow improvement.
- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com): GitHub homepage showcasing AI-powered developer platform with Copilot, Actions, and Codespaces.
